mapping_reviews.reason: Article 10 focuses on the quality, governance, and bias assessment of training data sets, but does not address the exclusion of institutional data or the provision of an enforceable opt-out mechanism.
Article 13 concerns the transparency of high-risk AI systems and the information to be provided to deployers, but does not address the exclusion of institutional data from training or opt-out rights.
Article 25(4) addresses contractual obligations between providers and third parties to ensure compliance, but does not address the exclusion of institutional data from training or opt-out rights.

applicability_note: No additional applicability condition is identified.
challenge_comment: The existing mappings are incorrect as none of the reviewed provisions address the specific control objective of excluding institutional data from training or providing an enforceable opt-out. The provisions relate to data quality, system transparency, and third-party contracts, which are materially different obligations.
